instruction: A candid wide-angle photograph depicts a motion capture studio with a red carpeted floor and white walls. On the left, the woman in the white t-shirt and blue jeans (R2) stands facing right, extending her right arm forward. On the right, the man in the dark polo shirt and blue shorts (R1) stands upright facing her, looking down as she touches his chest with her hand. The background features tripods, wall-mounted cameras, and a radiator. Bright overhead lighting evenly illuminates the entire room, casting subtle shadows on the floor.
elements: R2 extends her right arm forward to touch R1's chest
R1 is the person receiving the chest touch from R2
R1 stands upright facing R2 while R2 makes hand-to-chest contact
R2 faces R1 with her arm extended toward him
motion capture studio setting with tripods and wall-mounted cameras

questions.q: Is R2 extending her right arm forward to touch R1's chest, rather than R1 extending his arm to touch R2's chest?
